nodes.definition: Artificial intelligence, machine learning, neural networks, foundation models, and autonomous intelligent systems.

sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must reference an AI system or capability, not generic tech
excerpt must reference a trained model or learning process
excerpt must reference neural-network-based learning
excerpt must be about computational neural nets
excerpt must name or describe a large pretrained model
excerpt must reference a large language model or its output
excerpt must describe a system acting without step-by-step human control

nodes.definition: Space exploration, astronautics, astrophysics, orbital mechanics, planetary science, and empirical scientific inquiry.

sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must describe exploring space, not atmospheric flight
excerpt must describe real astronautical activity
excerpt must describe empirical astronomical observation
excerpt must reference orbits or spacecraft trajectories
excerpt must describe spacecraft hardware or systems
excerpt must describe empirical scientific inquiry

nodes.definition: Software engineering tooling, agent harnesses, IDE extensions, coding assistants, SDKs, and developer-focused workflows.
exclude: pure theoretical ML papers without tools

sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must show the tool assisting a coding task
excerpt must show a coding-specific agent scaffold
excerpt must describe a software engineering workflow
excerpt must name an SDK or library used by developers
excerpt must reference an IDE/code editor integration
excerpt must describe generating source code

nodes.definition: AI safety, cybersecurity, agent sandboxing, prompt injection defenses, vulnerability analysis, and governance guardrails.
exclude: generic network security without AI component

sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must describe a safety constraint on an AI agent
excerpt must describe an exploitable security flaw
excerpt must tie sandboxing to an AI model/agent
excerpt must reference prompt injection specifically
excerpt must describe technical runtime control of AI behavior
excerpt must tie least-privilege to an AI system's permissions

nodes.definition: Architectures, capability evaluations, multimodal systems, scaling behavior, and releases of frontier foundation models.

sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must describe the model's architecture itself
excerpt must announce a multimodal model release
excerpt must discuss model scaling behavior
excerpt must compare model capability/performance
excerpt must reference open-weight model availability

nodes.definition: Lectures, pedagogical explanations, conceptual deep dives, tutorials, and fundamental principles of machine learning.

sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must teach a concept, not announce a product
excerpt must explain how an algorithm works
excerpt must be ML-specific coursework content
excerpt must cover ML-relevant math
excerpt must walk through a technical process pedagogically

nodes.definition: Rocket propulsion, orbital spaceflight missions, spacecraft operations, astronaut activities, and commercial launch systems.

sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must describe a real rocket launch
excerpt must describe astronauts on a mission
excerpt must describe orbital (not atmospheric) maneuvering
excerpt must describe deploying an orbital satellite
excerpt must describe an actual EVA/spacewalk
excerpt must describe resupplying an orbital station

nodes.definition: AI agent products that autonomously execute real-world, multi-step tasks and workflows for a user or business, including sensing/acting personas, task-completion agents, business-process agents, and persistent monitoring assistants.
include: AI agent product described as sensing, acting, remembering, and understanding like a coworker or friend
agent completes multi-step real-world tasks end-to-end (booking, shopping, research) without step-by-step direction
AI agents autonomously running full business functions (sales, underwriting, coaching) without human operators
agent-driven workflow where agents autonomously plan, execute, and deliver on a stated goal
vision of a persistent AI assistant that continuously watches screens or meetings to act for the user
exclude: coding-specific agent harnesses, IDE tools, or SDKs for software engineers -> AI and ML / Developer Tools
model architecture or benchmark evaluation without a shown real-world task -> AI and ML / Frontier Models
a finished generated video, image, or film shown as creative output -> AI and ML / Generative Media
company market position, revenue, funding, or rivalry commentary without a task demo -> AI and ML / AI Industry and Business

sibling_cues.include_cue: AI agent product described as sensing, acting, remembering, and understanding like a coworker or friend
sibling_cues.confusing_alternative: AI Industry and Business company narrative
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must describe the product's own multi-faceted capability, not company positioning

sibling_cues.include_cue: agent completes multi-step real-world tasks end-to-end (booking, shopping, research) without step-by-step direction
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: task target must be a real-world consumer action, not software engineering

sibling_cues.include_cue: AI agents autonomously running full business functions (sales, underwriting, coaching) without human operators
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must show the agent performing the function, not commentary about the company

sibling_cues.include_cue: agent-driven workflow where agents autonomously plan, execute, and deliver on a stated goal
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must describe the autonomous planning/execution process, not just the resulting artifact

sibling_cues.include_cue: vision of a persistent AI assistant that continuously watches screens or meetings to act for the user
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must describe ongoing autonomous monitoring/action, not benchmark scores

nodes.definition: News and commentary on the AI industry's competitive, financial, and policy dynamics, including company rivalries, revenue and market share, government restrictions on AI companies, and market/usage economics.
include: executive or public figure names who is winning the AI competitive race
government policy or restriction reported as affecting an AI company's competitive position
commentary that a company now faces real competition in the AI market
industry-wide analysis of usage share versus revenue capture between open and closed AI providers
reported revenue or annual recurring revenue (ARR) figures for an AI company
exclude: technical model architecture, benchmarks, or capability evaluation -> AI and ML / Frontier Models
an agent product demonstrating task execution itself -> AI and ML / AI Agents and Automation
a finished AI-generated creative artifact shown as the output -> AI and ML / Generative Media
coding-tool usage or IDE/SDK workflow steps -> AI and ML / Developer Tools

sibling_cues.include_cue: executive or public figure names who is winning the AI competitive race
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must center on competitive ranking/business strategy, not a benchmark score

sibling_cues.include_cue: government policy or restriction reported as affecting an AI company's competitive position
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must be about external policy/regulation, not internal safety mechanisms

sibling_cues.include_cue: commentary that a company now faces real competition in the AI market
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must be a competitive-landscape claim, not a model spec

sibling_cues.include_cue: industry-wide analysis of usage share versus revenue capture between open and closed AI providers
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must frame the comparison in market/revenue terms

sibling_cues.include_cue: reported revenue or annual recurring revenue (ARR) figures for an AI company
sibling_cues.confusing_alternative: AI Agents and Automation product demo
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must state a dollar/revenue figure, not describe a task the product performs

nodes.definition: AI systems and products whose demonstrated output is a finished visual creative artifact -- animation, film, or image/video-generated website -- produced from prompts or automated pipelines.
include: prompt-driven 3D or claymation-style animation generated as the shown output
an AI-generated short film entered in or winning an AI-specific film award
an AI animated film premiered at a creative or computer-graphics industry event
AI image/video generation models used to build a visual website shown as the output
AI-generated video content praised firsthand for its entertainment or creative quality
exclude: model architecture, scaling, or benchmark coverage described in the abstract -> AI and ML / Frontier Models
an agent autonomously completing a real-world non-creative task -> AI and ML / AI Agents and Automation
company market position or revenue commentary -> AI and ML / AI Industry and Business
a coding/SDK workflow used to build the artifact rather than the artifact itself -> AI and ML / Developer Tools

sibling_cues.include_cue: prompt-driven 3D or claymation-style animation generated as the shown output
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must show the produced animation, not a model's architecture claim

sibling_cues.include_cue: an AI-generated short film entered in or winning an AI-specific film award
sibling_cues.confusing_alternative: AI Industry and Business award/market news
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must be about the film itself, not company standing

sibling_cues.include_cue: an AI animated film premiered at a creative or computer-graphics industry event
sibling_cues.confusing_alternative: AI Agents and Automation product launch
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must show the finished film as output, not an agent's task steps

sibling_cues.include_cue: AI image/video generation models used to build a visual website shown as the output
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must showcase the generated visual result, not the coding process

sibling_cues.include_cue: AI-generated video content praised firsthand for its entertainment or creative quality
sibling_cues.evidence_needed: excerpt must describe the video's content/quality, not business positioning
